text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It's showdown time with Dober from the Mejiro family! Even if the divine dares to claim that differences in the environment one is raised in leads to differences in strength—I disagree!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'll win this race to prove that the bonds you form with other people can be even stronger than familial bonds!
